scope: Retained execution-correctness findings; intentional unrestricted paper financial policy was not treated as a defect.

findings: New external holdings can restore inferred fee deductions and be consumed by owned exits.
Marketable replay entries can fill above the live ask-priced limit.
Concurrent external acquisitions and owned partial fills can still mask unposted fees.
A lagged empty position response can become a permanent ownership debit.
Positive partial position lag with unposted fees can strand acknowledged owned credits.
Separate cycle/account-projection commits can apply an external disposal twice after interruption.

iterations.production_observation: Actual fills completed, but false mixed-inventory classification and redundant broker reads caused repeated 429 responses and a delayed exit.

findings: Foreign segregation omitted unacknowledged dispatched owned BUY exposure.
A lagged external-position response could permanently reduce the foreign reserve despite later attributable fee and balance evidence.

iterations.actual_corrected_observation: 1803.83 seconds, 604 successful dashboard requests, no sampled runtime/resource failures, no broker 429 records in the corrected run at final readback. Two already-filled cancel races recovered and remain in the audit.
